item.g:title: Frog Candle
item.g:description: A green frog with rosy cheeks and a little golden crown – half fairy tale, half wink. Put him on a shelf, a desk or next to the bathtub and he will make everyone smile. Each figure is cast in plaster and painted by hand in our studio in Switzerland. The top part lifts off: inside is a soy wax candle in the scent of your choice. Once the candle has burned down, the frog stays on as decor or a little box for jewellery and odds and ends.

item.g:title: Frog in a Hat Candle
item.g:description: This frog has dressed up for autumn: a brown hat with a buckle, rosy cheeks and a contented look. A little character for the windowsill, a shelf or the autumn table. Each figure is cast in plaster and painted by hand in Switzerland. The top part lifts off: inside is a soy wax candle in the scent of your choice. Once it has burned down, the frog stays on as decor or a storage box.

item.g:title: Hyacinth Candle
item.g:description: A hyacinth with dense, delicate clusters of blossoms – the first hello of spring for the windowsill, Easter table or bedside. Cast in plaster and painted by hand in Switzerland. The top part lifts off: inside is a soy wax candle in the scent of your choice. Afterwards the hyacinth stays on as spring decor that never wilts.

item.g:title: Pumpkin Candle
item.g:description: A little pumpkin house with a witch's hat, a wooden door and tiny windows – the cosiest resident of your autumn table. Cast in plaster and painted by hand in our studio in Switzerland. Simply lift off the hat: underneath is a soy wax candle in the scent of your choice. Afterwards the pumpkin house stays on as autumn decor or a box for small things.

item.g:title: Carousel Candle
item.g:description: A carousel with horses in relief and a domed roof with a little spire. The details are hand-painted in silver, red or gold. Cast in plaster and painted by hand in Switzerland. The top part lifts off: inside is a soy wax candle in the scent of your choice. Afterwards the carousel stays on as a box for jewellery and small treasures, or as a decoration on the shelf.

item.g:title: Christmas Bauble Candle
item.g:description: A Christmas bauble you don't hang on the tree – you light it. With a snowflake relief, in blue or gold. Cast in plaster and painted by hand in Switzerland. The top part lifts off: inside is a soy wax candle in the scent of your choice. Afterwards the bauble stays on as a little box or Christmas decoration.

item.g:title: Mouse King Candle — Red
item.g:description: The Mouse King from «The Nutcracker» – in a red uniform with golden buttons, a ruff and a crown. At 20 cm our largest piece and a real eye-catcher at Christmas. Cast in plaster and painted by hand in Switzerland. The top part lifts off: inside is a soy wax candle in the scent of your choice. Afterwards the Mouse King stays on as a collector's figure.

item.g:title: Roly-Poly Doll Candle
item.g:description: Rosy cheeks, big blue eyes and a little heart on her cheek: our roly-poly doll is inspired by the much-loved toy of childhood. Each doll is cast in plaster and painted by hand in Switzerland – so every one has her own expression. The top part lifts off: inside is a soy wax candle in the scent of your choice. Once it has burned down, the doll stays on as a keepsake box or winter decoration on the windowsill.
